A damage script with a static dummy does not meet the animation requirement.

playerExperience.title: Strike Lab - Combat Training Arena
playerExperience.summary: Strike Lab is a focused, responsive fighting-game training arena tailored for desktop and mobile touch devices. The player enters a modern combat dojo equipped with a training dummy, an interactive HUD tracking dummy health and hit count, and intuitive controls (Left-Click/F key on desktop, dedicated on-screen touch buttons on mobile). The combat system features an authored three-hit light-attack combo with distinct windup, contact, and recovery phases. The server strictly validates attack cadence, active contact windows, and player-to-dummy proximity, preventing button-holding exploits and recovery spam. Each valid strike produces synchronized audio, kinetic hit-stop effects, and floating damage numbers, while out-of-range attacks provide immediate miss feedback. Defeating the dummy triggers a knockout sequence and automatic reset, alongside a manual reset control for continuous training.
playerExperience.visualDirection: A clean, modern minimalist combat training dojo ('Strike Lab') featuring a polished dark-slate and neon-accented arena floor, ambient boundary lighting, and focused lighting on the central training ring. The training dummy stands centered on a marked sparring circle with high-contrast health and hit indicators overhead. Attack strikes emit crisp energy arcs and kinetic impact sparks, while floating combat text clearly differentiates 'HIT' (with damage number and combo count) from 'MISS' feedback. The HUD features a sleek, uncluttered fighting-game health bar, dynamic combo counter, and unobtrusive touch controls for mobile players.
